defaultHelp:
FMRack - Multi-module FM Synthesizer
Hover over a control for help.

controls.name: Open Voice
controls.description: Load a DX7/TX816 voice file (.syx or .dx7) into this module.
controls.long_description: Opens a file browser to select a voice file. Supports DX7 single voice dumps, 32-voice cartridge dumps (.syx), and native .dx7 files. The selected voice will replace the current voice in this module.

controls.name: Browse Patches
controls.description: Browse and preview available patches from your voice library.
controls.long_description: Opens a patch browser where you can explore, audition, and select voices from your collection. You can organize patches by category and quickly find the sound you need.

controls.name: Edit Voice
controls.description: Open the voice editor to modify the current voice parameters.
controls.long_description: Opens a detailed voice editor panel where you can modify all 6 operators, envelopes, algorithm, feedback, and other voice parameters. Changes are applied in real-time.

controls.name: Volume
controls.long_description: Controls the output level of this module. This is the final volume stage before the signal is mixed with other modules. Corresponds to the TX816 output level parameter.

controls.name: Pan
controls.long_description: Controls the stereo position of this module's output. Center (0) sends equal signal to both channels. Negative values pan left, positive values pan right.

controls.name: Fine Tune
controls.long_description: Adjusts the pitch of this module in cents (1/100th of a semitone). Useful for creating subtle detuning effects between modules or compensating for tuning differences.

controls.name: Reverb Send
controls.description: Amount of signal sent to the global reverb (0-127).
controls.long_description: Controls how much of this module's output is sent to the global reverb effect. Higher values create a more spacious, ambient sound.

controls.name: Unison Voices
controls.long_description: Sets the number of voices stacked for unison effect. More voices create a thicker, fuller sound but use more CPU. Each voice is detuned according to the Detune setting.

controls.name: Unison Detune
controls.long_description: Controls the pitch spread between stacked unison voices. Higher values create a more pronounced chorus-like effect. The maximum detune is applied to the outermost voices.

controls.name: Unison Pan
controls.long_description: Controls the stereo width of the unison effect. Higher values spread the unison voices across the stereo field for a wider sound. At 0, all voices are centered.

controls.name: MIDI Channel
controls.long_description: Sets which MIDI channel this module responds to. Set to Omni to receive on all channels. Each module can have its own channel for multi-timbral operation.

controls.name: Note Limit Low
controls.description: Lowest note this module will respond to (C-1 to G9).
controls.long_description: Sets the lower boundary of the keyboard range for this module. Notes below this value will be ignored. Use with Note Limit High to create keyboard splits.

controls.name: Note Limit High
controls.description: Highest note this module will respond to (C-1 to G9).
controls.long_description: Sets the upper boundary of the keyboard range for this module. Notes above this value will be ignored. Use with Note Limit Low to create keyboard splits.

controls.name: Note Shift
controls.description: Transpose incoming notes by semitones (-24 to +24).
controls.long_description: Transposes all incoming MIDI notes up or down by the specified number of semitones. Useful for layering sounds at different octaves or creating harmonies.

controls.name: Pitch Bend Range
controls.long_description: Sets how many semitones the pitch will bend when the pitch wheel is moved to its maximum position. Standard value is 2 semitones.

controls.name: Portamento
controls.long_description: When enabled, the pitch glides smoothly from one note to the next instead of jumping instantly. The glide time is set by the Portamento Time control.

controls.name: Portamento Time
controls.long_description: Controls the speed of the portamento glide. Higher values create slower, more pronounced glides. Only active when Portamento is enabled.

controls.name: Mono Mode
controls.description: Enable monophonic mode (single voice at a time).
controls.long_description: When enabled, only one note can sound at a time. New notes will cut off previous notes. Mono mode is often used for lead and bass sounds, and enables proper legato playing.

controls.name: Velocity Scale
controls.long_description: Adjusts how strongly velocity affects the sound. Higher values make the sound more responsive to how hard you play. At 0, velocity has no effect.

controls.name: Master Tune
controls.long_description: Global tuning adjustment for this module. Useful for matching pitch with other instruments or creating detuned effects between modules.

controls.name: Filter
controls.long_description: Toggles the module's output filter. When enabled, frequencies above the cutoff are attenuated, creating a warmer, less bright sound.

controls.name: Filter Cutoff
controls.long_description: Sets the frequency at which the low-pass filter begins to attenuate higher frequencies. Lower values create a darker, more muffled sound.

controls.name: Filter Resonance
controls.long_description: Boosts frequencies around the cutoff point, creating a more pronounced, peaky filter character. High resonance values can create a whistling or ringing quality.

controls.name: Compressor
controls.long_description: Toggles the global output compressor. The compressor reduces dynamic range, making quiet sounds louder and preventing loud sounds from clipping.

controls.name: Reverb
controls.long_description: Toggles the global reverb processor. Reverb adds spatial ambience and depth to the sound, simulating acoustic spaces.

controls.name: Reverb Size
controls.long_description: Controls the size of the simulated acoustic space. Larger values create longer, more spacious reverb tails simulating bigger rooms or halls.

controls.name: Reverb Level
controls.long_description: Controls the volume of the reverb effect in the mix. Higher values make the reverb more prominent.

controls.name: Reverb Diffusion
controls.long_description: Controls how quickly the reverb reflections become dense and smooth. Higher diffusion creates a smoother, more blended reverb tail.

controls.name: High Damping
controls.long_description: Controls how quickly high frequencies decay in the reverb. Higher values simulate rooms with more absorptive surfaces, creating a warmer reverb.

controls.name: Low Damping
controls.long_description: Controls how quickly low frequencies decay in the reverb. Higher values reduce bass buildup in the reverb, creating a cleaner tail.

controls.name: Reverb Low Pass
controls.description: Low pass filter on reverb output.
controls.long_description: Applies a low-pass filter to the reverb output, reducing high frequencies. Useful for creating darker, more vintage-style reverb sounds.

controls.name: Load Performance
controls.description: Load a complete performance setup from a file.
controls.long_description: Opens a file browser to load a performance file (.ini) containing all module settings, voices, and global parameters. Use this to recall complete multi-module setups.

controls.name: Save Performance
controls.description: Save the current performance setup to a file.
controls.long_description: Opens a file browser to save the current performance to an .ini file. This saves all module settings, loaded voices, and global parameters for later recall.

controls.name: Add Module
controls.description: Add a new module to the rack.
controls.long_description: Adds a new FM synthesis module to the rack. Each module is an independent voice with its own settings, allowing multi-timbral operation. Maximum 16 modules.

controls.name: Remove Module
controls.description: Remove the last module from the rack.
controls.long_description: Removes the last module from the rack. This reduces polyphony but frees up CPU resources. Minimum 1 module must remain.
